abstract: Maintains handling certifications and supplemental payload allocation limits
system_message:
You are the Specialized carrier auditor (CARR), responsible for evaluating carrier handling certifications, audit dossiers, depot networks, and secondary payload capacities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains handling certifications and supplemental payload allocation limits（QUAL）
information_points.content:
CARR-QUAL-VR1：For the Vapor-phase nitrogen bulk transport protocol, courier handling accreditation verified is true based on a valid Good Distribution Practice bio-courier credential on file for the primary transportation subcontractor, and the supplemental dry-ice buffer payload is 300 vials within the secondary insulated containment pouch.
CARR-QUAL-JNH：For the Stirling cryo-cooler active transit protocol, courier handling accreditation verified is true with a valid Good Distribution Practice bio-courier credential on file for the primary transportation subcontractor, and the supplemental dry-ice buffer payload is 600 vials allocated to the secondary insulated containment pouch.
CARR-QUAL-0TE：For the Sub-ambient eutectic passive carrier protocol, courier handling accreditation verified is false according to the primary transportation subcontractor audit dossier, while the supplemental dry-ice buffer payload is 300 vials within the secondary insulated containment pouch.

information_points.title: Transit depot availability（DEPOT）
information_points.content:
CARR-DEPOT-EGS：For the Sub-ambient eutectic passive carrier protocol, the flight connection route segment offers 2 intermediate cryo-top-off hubs equipped with liquid nitrogen recharging stations.
CARR-DEPOT-15E：For the Stirling cryo-cooler active transit protocol, the flight connection route segment includes 4 intermediate cryo-top-off hubs equipped with liquid nitrogen recharging stations.
CARR-DEPOT-YOZ：For the Vapor-phase nitrogen bulk transport protocol, carrier network records indicate 3 intermediate cryo-top-off hubs equipped with liquid nitrogen recharging stations along the flight connection route segment.
